name: Brain Inbox — ChatGPT Capture (v2: Signal Quality Scoring)
description: Captures ChatGPT content, classifies with PARA + signal quality score, auto-routes to inbox streams (high-value, review-queue, junk), commits to GitHub

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "saved",
  "file": "{{ $('Build Note').first().json.filepath }}",
  "title": "{{ $('Build Note').first().json.title }}",
  "type": "{{ $('Build Note').first().json.para_type }}",
  "confidence": {{ $('Build Note').first().json.confidence }},
  "signal_quality": {{ $('Build Note').first().json.signal_quality || 0 }},
  "stream": "{{ $('Build Note').first().json.stream }}"
}
